For your gluten-free bread recipe, the best alternative to all-purpose flour to maintain an airy structure is a high-quality **gluten-free all-purpose flour blend** that specifically includes **xanthan gum** or **guar gum**. These gums mimic the elasticity and binding properties of gluten, which is crucial for trapping air and allowing the dough to rise properly.

If your current blend does not contain a gum, you can add 1/2 to 1 teaspoon of xanthan gum per cup of flour. Alternatively, a blend based on **rice flour and tapioca starch** (or potato starch) tends to produce a lighter, fluffier crumb compared to blends heavy in almond or coconut flour, which can be denser.
